comments.content: [medium] The first for-each loop walks every RPN element without any type filtering. Element kinds like FUNCTION_AND, FUNCTION_OR, FUNCTION_NOT, and ALWAYS_TRUE carry no monotonic_functions_chain, so skipping them early would avoid needless function calls and make the intent clearer. Consider adding a condition that rules out irrelevant element types before the monotonic chain check.
[low] Please document what callers should expect when `elem.set_index->size() != 1` is unavailable.
[low] Please make the error behavior for `elem.set_index->size() != 1` explicit instead of relying on the caller to infer it.
